name: public-tracker-search
description: Present so that Node reads the .js files as ES modules. No dependencies, no install step, no lockfile.

UTSI_API_KEY.description: The key every request to your Worker must carry. Make one at [the setup page](https://momzv2022-ctrl.github.io/public-tracker-search/) — it mints one in your browser and sends it nowhere — or invent one of at least 16 characters. Your Worker shows it back to you on its front page. Leave it empty and the Worker refuses every request.
